fixes.title: Add Product and Offer data to the product page
fixes.why: Shopping agents look for Product structured data. The product page has none an agent can use.
fixes.how: Add a valid Product JSON-LD block with name and an Offer with price, priceCurrency and availability.

fixes.title: Server-render the product name
fixes.why: The product name only appears after JavaScript runs.

fixes.title: Fix the JSON-LD syntax error
fixes.why: One JSON-LD block does not parse, so agents discard it.
fixes.how: Correct the JSON syntax on the product page.

fixes.title: Label the phone field
fixes.why: The phone field in the cart has no label.

fixes.title: Complete OpenGraph tags
fixes.how: Follow the guide at https://ogp.me/ and add both tags.

fixes.title: Date the sitemap
fixes.why: The sitemap has no lastmod dates, and check F7 also shows the server is slow.

fixes.title: Label the phone field in the cart
fixes.why: Two of three cart fields are labelled; the phone field is not.
fixes.how: Add a <label for> to the phone input.

fixes.title: Add og:image and og:url
fixes.why: The home page is missing og:image and og:url.
fixes.how: Add both meta tags to the home page head.
